stdout.why: Static \Drupal:: service access is discouraged (and brittle to test).

stdout.fix: Use the 'spaceless' filter via {% apply spaceless %} ... {% endapply %}, or explicit whitespace control.
Keep/restore 'implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface' and its use statement (check-port-safety.sh).
stdout.why: A class with create() must implement ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (plugins) or ContainerInjectionInterface (forms/controllers); QueueWorkerBase, BlockBase, FilterBase, ActionBase and core PluginBase do not provide it.

stdout.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().
stdout.why: Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::getOriginal(): ?static (implemented by EntityBase). An entity class that already declares its own getOriginal() without a compatible return type is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+; a compatible one silently replaces core's method there.

stdout.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: $users = \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('user')->loadByProperties(['name' => $name]) (or ['mail' => $mail]); $account = $users ? reset($users) : FALSE; - works on Drupal 10 and 11.
stdout.why: user_load_by_name()/user_load_by_mail() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core (a SOFT deprecation).

stdout.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed while the core floor is below 11.4: DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.4.0', fn() => \Drupal::service(TextSummary::class)->generate($text, $format, $size), fn() => text_summary($text, $format, $size)) - a bare TextSummary call fatals on older cores. generate() needs an int size: pass the text.settings default_summary_length when the original passed NULL.
stdout.why: text_summary() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). Its replacement, the TextSummary service, exists only from Drupal 11.4.

stdout.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: return a render array ['#type' => 'processed_text', '#text' => $text, '#format' => $format_id] instead of flattened markup (works on Drupal 10 and 11, and keeps the cacheability metadata); the call site changes from a string to a render array.
stdout.why: check_markup() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). There is no direct replacement.

stdout.fix: Use \Drupal\user\Entity\Role::loadMultiple() (available on Drupal 10) and filter inline: user_roles(TRUE) excluded the anonymous role (RoleInterface::ANONYMOUS_ID); user_role_names() mapped the roles to $role->label().
stdout.why: user_roles() and user_role_names() were deprecated in drupal:10.2.0 and REMOVED in drupal:11.0.0: a call is an undefined-function fatal on every Drupal 11 core (a HARD deprecation, always fixed in Phase 1).
